## Bat Distribution in the White Mountians
For this project, I am using Sonobat to analyze Autonomous Recording Unit information from various locations in the white mountains. From this, we will have a better understanding of species distribution amoung varied levels of elevation.


## Spatial Abundance of Eastern Box Turtles
This project was from an internship I worked on over the summer. I focused on determining the home ranges of Eastern Box Turtles at Brookhaven National Lab. I used a dataset starting from 2003 to the present day.
